chunks: And in another report: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a man who bequeathed one-third of his wealth, and then was killed by mistake.
He عليه السلام said: "One-third of his blood money is included in his bequest."
ai.seo_question: Is one-third of a mistakenly killed person's diyyah included in his bequest?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bequest made before a person is killed by mistake. It states that one-third of the diyyah received on account of his death is counted within the estate subject to his wasiyyah.
